# Issue 1810: migration diagnostics

Source reviewed: production candidate `ae2eba84283939f5991a1b0c35c32ba351f9efdc`. The pending change is documentation and teaching snippets only. Lead's later `c6831b807218a492ff75b5945e891716a410f47d` commit adds internal evidence; the framework implementation under test is unchanged.

## Item 1: incomplete handler diagnostic priority

Reproduced. Starting with the real compiler-diagnostics fixture, a `makeUpdate` record that omits `CompletedSave` and returns a connected recipe for `Clicked` first reports TS2322 that ResultRecipe lacks a Model. It does not directly name the missing handler. The complete canonical control passes.

The active Update guide now has a completeness-first troubleshooting section, with matching stable-migration and previous-preview entries. It explicitly says this is a diagnostic-reporting limitation, does not claim priority was fixed, and warns against adding a Model to a recipe or casting the error away. Generated child envelopes remain automatically routed and do not need handlers. This item is documented and assessed; compiler diagnostic prioritization remains unresolved. No type signature or budget was changed to hide it.

## Item 2: local and connected branches

Reproduced sound rejection with the exact dedicated diagnostic. A raw local `{ model }` beside a connected Binding recipe is invalid; replacing only that local result with the owner's `makeNoopStep()(model)` is accepted. Added short matched before/after snippet files immediately beside the dedicated diagnostic in the Update guide. The text distinguishes branches of one handler from unrelated raw-only handlers, so it does not recommend wrapping every handler.

## Item 3: deferred and applied Step composition

Reproduced sound rejection when a Definition-owned producer applies `combineSteps(model, steps)` to its ordinary domain Model. Returning the deferred `combineSteps(steps)` is accepted. Added the rejected applied counterpart directly beside the existing verified deferred snippet, plus migration troubleshooting links. The guide explains that contextual Composition handlers already have registration and may use the data-first form there. Deferral does not add an execution phase or schedule Commands.

## Verification

- `results.json`: incomplete, mixed-local/connected and applied-producer controls reject; the complete canonical/deferred control passes using the current emitted public Foldkit API.
- `snippet-results.json`: all three checked good snippets pass; both bad teaching snippets reject with their intended mixed-result or registered-Composition diagnostics.
- `framework-diagnostics.log`: the existing official source and physically relocated emitted diagnostic acceptance/rejection harness passes. Existing missing-record rejection remains in `declaration-tests/record-update.rejected.ts`; no safety fixture was weakened or duplicated.
- `documentation-tests.log`: all 954 documentation tests pass, including snippet references and titles.
- Formatting and diff whitespace checks pass. Targeted application lint passes under a temporary copy of the same application rules with the teaching-directory ignore removed, enabling the check for these files. Repository lint configuration remains unchanged.

## Owned changes

- `packages/website/src/page/core/update.md`
- `packages/website/src/page/previewMigration.md`
- `packages/website/src/page/previewUpgrade.md`

No framework source/type/API, compiler budget, Runtime/DevTools, historical post or published Ready snapshot was edited. No commit, push or external post was performed. Runtime/DevTools snapshot preservation is a separate concurrent investigation owned by the lead team.
